fields.description: Altan is a residential tower with one to three bedroom apartments and three bedroom townhouses in Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour. Private balconies and townhouse roof terraces sit alongside landscaped communal areas. The brochure adds co-working spaces, a padel court and indoor and outdoor fitness areas to the pool and family facilities.

overview: Altan gives shared spaces several distinct roles: co-working for quieter work, a padel court and gyms for activity, and a lawn, dining area and pools for time with others. The brochure describes fitted bedroom wardrobes, kitchen cabinetry and a high-ceilinged lobby. Beyond the building, Green Gate’s planned parks and recreation network form the neighbourhood setting; access and opening dates should be checked separately.
research.locationNote: Altan is in Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour. The developer’s brochure places Creek Beach and the promenade within the wider community and shows road connections towards Downtown Dubai and the airports. Exact walking routes, commuting times and the selected apartment’s outlook require a unit-level check.
research.priceNote: Emaar displays a units-from price of AED 1,813,888 on the research date. This published figure is not confirmation that a home at that price remains available. Obtain a current unit quotation and terms.
research.paymentNote: The reviewed launch plan has 10% at booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Dated launch obligations are retained below for context; some have already passed. A current agreement may require a different payment position.
research.handoverNote: July 2029 is the estimated construction-completion month in Altan’s launch payment sheet, also reported by Property Finder. Contractual handover and current construction progress need confirmation.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: Altan’s fact sheet lists 479 homes: 211 one bedroom, 210 two bedroom and 52 three bedroom apartments, plus six three bedroom townhouses. This is a launch breakdown, not a current stock count.

facts.label: Historical type prices
facts.value: The launch sheet quoted AED 1.81 million, AED 2.71 million and AED 4.11 million for one to three bedroom apartments respectively; three bedroom townhouses started at AED 6.95 million.

facts.label: Tower configuration
facts.value: The official plans identify B+G+3P+53. Apartment areas vary by floor group; compare the actual unit drawing rather than relying only on a general bedroom range.

facts.label: Townhouse arrangement
facts.value: Three-level townhouses include a maid’s room, roof terraces and storage. Internal suites measure 2,439.32–2,443.84 sq ft. Published totals add substantial terrace/balcony areas; they are not entirely enclosed living space.

unresolved: Launch fact-sheet maxima of 776 sq ft for one bedroom and 1,455 sq ft for two are not fully represented in the reviewed official plan pages; additional layout documentation is needed.
